title: Security Certificate Entity
description: Defines TLS/SSL certificate configuration. Used by enjoin-certificate to provision certificates via ACME, self-signed, or manual placement.

domains.description: Domain names for the certificate (first is primary, rest are SANs).

server.description: ACME server URL (default: Let's Encrypt production).

dns_provider.description: DNS provider plugin for dns-01 challenge.

cert_path.description: Where to place the certificate file.

key_path.description: Where to place the private key file.

chain_path.description: Where to place the CA chain file.

fullchain_path.description: Where to place the full chain (cert + CA chain).

renew_before_days.description: Renew when fewer than N days remain.

notify.description: Command to run after renewal (e.g., systemctl reload nginx).
